03Student visa

The student visa, step by step

With an admission from a recognised university or school, you can apply for a student stay and work part-time while you study.

  1. 1

    Choose and apply

    We shortlist programmes that fit your grades, language and budget.

  2. 2

    Admission letter

    With the letter in hand, the visa file can start.

  3. 3

    Funds and documents

    You show €600 a month for living costs and prepare the file with us.

  4. 4

    Study and work

    In Spain you can work up to 30 hours a week alongside your studies.

General guidance, not legal advice. Rules change, so we confirm the figures for your case.
